case_title: BODIN, GREGORY VS O' DRISCOLL, AILEEN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY BODIN, GREGORY AS TO DEFENDANT O' DRISCOLL, AILEEN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-28-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
CLAIM OF DEFENDANT FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY O' DRISCOLL, AILEEN AS TO CROSS DEFENDANT BODIN, GREGORY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-28-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
